maya: Quick async check — posting a compact Qtr milestone pulse for the cross-team OKR. Reply with short lines: Shipped | Slipped | Owner | Blocker | ETA. I'll compile after responses.

aj: Shipped: routing-policy UI (console + canary). Owner: aj. PR: https://github.com/redwood/console/pull/1789. No blockers — canary healthy.

david: Slipped: private-deploy docs (airgap/VPC runbook). Owner: david. Blocker: legal review + failing on-prem e2e. Short log: ```error: mount timeout: /var/lib/model-data``` ETA: ~2w. Ticket: https://rwd/issues/1212

sara: Shipped: dedicated autoscale tuning (sigma-3 config). Owner: sara. Observed ~8% cost drop on the perf harness. Follow-up: docs PR next sprint.

leo: Slipped: quant recommendation pipeline (beta). Owner: leo. Blocker: downstream eval regressions in reranking (see eval-run 2026-03-13). ETA: ~1wk pending fixes.

maya: Noted. @sara can you pair with @david to repro the on-prem e2e fail? @david — which teams need to sign off for the docs?

david: Signoffs needed: security, platform-oncall, legal. I'll attach the failing runner logs to the ticket and add reproduction steps. @sara thanks — pinging you for a pairing window.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary rollout complete for routing-policy-ui — 2026-03-15T09:22Z :white_check_mark:

aj: Two small follow-ups left (analytics hook + metrics dashboard). Owner: aj. ETA: 48h. PRs: https://github.com/redwood/console/pull/1792

sara: I'll pair with @david tomorrow 10:30 PT to debug the mount issue and drop a short infra patch to increase mount retries.

maya: Thanks — I'll ping legal for the doc review and update the OKR sheet with current ETAs. Anyone else with slipped items to report?

leo: One more: A/B experiment for cache policy got delayed. Owner: leo. Blocker: missing IAM role for experiment infra. ETA: 3d.

maya: Great — action items: everyone, add owner + ETA to the OKR doc by EOD. I'll consolidate and send a ~1-paragraph summary to leadership after that. :pray:

aj: ack :thumbsup:

david: ack, adding logs to ticket now.

sara: ack, see you 10:30 PT.
